name: tallow
description: Tallow (working title): a tabletop roleplaying game played in one 3D room, for Lumiverse (Spindle).

scripts.verify: bun run test && bun run typecheck
scripts.models: echo Run each script in models/ with: blender --background --python models/NAME.py (props, narrator_cloak, narrator_arm, narrator_hood, pieces), then bun run embed. docs/ART.md has the style and the judge.
scripts.room: bun run build && bun run scripts/run-sit.ts
